card.name: The verb make before payments or decisions
card.fires_on: The verb "make" (or "making") after "to", "will", "should" or "how you'll", when it introduces an object like payments, purchases, decisions, money or investments. Mostly in finance, credit and policy writing.

modes.label: Make payments or purchases
modes.description: "make" followed by a payment, purchase or charge in money and credit text.
modes.example: Each month, you carry a balance (or revolve the debt) and<< make>> a payment.

modes.label: Make decisions or sure
modes.description: "make" in general policy or opinion text, before decisions, sure, or investments.
modes.example: who evaluates and measures sustainability, who should<< make>> decisions about strategy and how should

card.plain: It lights up on the verb "make" when it is about to be followed by things like a payment, a purchase or a decision.
